story.title: Meet the Mammals!
paragraphs_en: Do you know what's common to all these animals shown below? They are all Mammals ! Do you know what mammals are?

Mammals are animals that have a backbone, are warm-blooded and have hair on their bodies. They also produce milk to feed their babies. Mammals are very intelligent and can live anywhere including oceans, land or even underground! So, shall we meet some mammals now?
ELEPHANT Did you know? An adult elephant needs to drink around 210 litres of water a day.
CAT Did you know? Cats conserve energy by sleeping for an average of 13 to 14 hours a day.
BLUE WHALE Did you know? The blue whale can produce the loudest sound of any animal.
RHINOCEROS Did you know? Rhinoceros are herbivores (plant eaters) and can weigh upto 3500 kgs.
CAMEL Did you know? Camels have three sets of eyelids with two rows of eyelashes.
TIGER Did you know? Tigers are good swimmers and can swim up to 6 kilometres.
BAT Did you know? Bats are flying mammals and are nocturnal (active at night!)
BEAR Did you know? Unlike many mammals, bears can see in colour.
HUMANS Did you know? Humans are mammals too!
